name: Oxfam International
body: An NGO entity in JSON-LD, DMARC set to reject, framing limited, and language versions that link back. But three scripts sit in the <head> of /en without async or defer, so nothing paints until they load.
lesson: Add defer to scripts that don't need to run before first paint, or move them to the end of the body.
summary: www.oxfam.org scores 77 out of 100 (C). 4 checks fail now, 17 are at risk, and 21 pass. Fix first: HSTS is not sent.

fix.title: HSTS is not sent
fix.evidence: strict-transport-security was absent on the start page. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed. A first visit over http can be intercepted.

fix.title: 40 form controls have no label
fix.evidence: On /en, /en/blogs, /en/research, /en/press-releases and 16 more. Screen readers announce them as an unnamed field.
fix.fix: Pair each control with <label for>, wrap it in a label, or add aria-label.

fix.title: 17 pages have no meta description
fix.evidence: /en/blogs, /en/research, /en/press-releases, /en/what-we-do/issues and 13 more. Google and AI answers then write their own snippet from whatever text they find.
fix.fix: Write a 50 to 160 character description for each page that says what a reader gets.

fix.title: Referrer-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Browsers fall back to their default. An explicit policy keeps full URLs from leaking to other sites. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Permissions-Policy is not sent
fix.evidence: Embedded content can ask for the camera, microphone, or location. Missing on all 20 pages analyzed.

fix.title: Tracking tags load with no consent tool in the page
fix.evidence: Google Tag Manager appears in the HTML and no consent platform or Google Consent Mode default was found. In the EU, the UK, Brazil, and Colombia this is a legal exposure.
fix.fix: Add a consent platform and set Google Consent Mode v2 defaults to denied before any tag loads.

works.title: Every internal link that was opened answered
AI answer and search crawlers may read the start page
Plain http redirects permanently to https
The start page declares its language
A sitemap answers with valid URLs
Language alternates point at each other
